notes: Installer fix: the upgrade now waits for the sensor service to actually stop before replacing its program file.

Cause: the installer asked Windows to stop the service and then immediately began extracting files. 'sc stop' returns as soon as the request is accepted, not when the service has finished stopping - and this service shuts down two child…
This is the same class of problem as the updater silently skipping locked sensor files, and it is worth stating plainly: an install that reports success is not proof the new files landed.
No change to the app itself in this version. The sensor-service performance work from 1.1.240 is unchanged and still arrives by running the installer.
